# sol-sweeper-bots

> Defensive explainer and read-only tools on why leaked Solana private keys are permanently unsafe and how sweeper bots exploit them.

sol-sweeper-bots is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/sol-sweeper-bots/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
- [Read](https://github.com/nirholas/sol-sweeper-bots/blob/HEAD/README.md#read)
- [Tools (read-only, no keys, no network writes)](https://github.com/nirholas/sol-sweeper-bots/blob/HEAD/README.md#tools-read-only-no-keys-no-network-writes)
- [Quick start](https://github.com/nirholas/sol-sweeper-bots/blob/HEAD/README.md#quick-start)
- [The one-sentence version](https://github.com/nirholas/sol-sweeper-bots/blob/HEAD/README.md#the-one-sentence-version)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/sol-sweeper-bots/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
- [Full text for LLMs](https://github.com/nirholas/sol-sweeper-bots/blob/HEAD/llms-full.txt): the README inlined
